description: Model T originally developed as a taxi bicycle in 2000–2001, drawing inspiration from traditional rickshaws from Vietnam. Model T therefore designed as a modern rickshaw for transporting passengers, with the passengers seated in the front. At the time, it was a groundbreaking design, as passengers typically sat behind the driver on rickshaws back then. By placing the passengers in front, there is good interaction between the driver and passengers, and passengers can also better enjoy the ride. From being a taxi bike with the primary purpose of transporting passengers or cargo from A to B, Model T has Model T evolved into a cargo bike for outdoor experiences. This development has been championed by many different organizations that have used Model T a social cargo bike for many years.
